prompt: When GPORCA (rather than the classic Postgres planner) is chosen as the optimizer, does it reuse the same direct-dispatch decision code, or does it have its own path? Where does GPORCA itself live in the tree, and where would I look for its equivalent of the direct-dispatch logic?

answer_points: GPORCA is a separate, independent dispatch decision path from the classic planner's cdbtargeteddispatch.c logic
GPORCA lives under src/backend/gporca/ and is written in C++
The relevant translation logic is CTranslatorExprToDXLUtils::SetDirectDispatchInfo in src/backend/gporca/libgpopt/src/translate/CTranslatorExprToDXLUtils.cpp
That function is what decides whether direct dispatch info gets attached to the DXL plan when GPORCA is used
Because the two paths are independent, a fix applied only to the planner path does not automatically cover the GPORCA path (and vice versa)
